blocks.text: Thereafter, laying ambush to the Mughal troops here and there, The Singhs began slaughtering enemy Mughal soldiers. As the Singhs waylaid the Mughals either from the front or the rearguard, Pathan soldiers were helpless in locating the Khalsa positions. (1)
lines: Thereafter, laying ambush to the Mughal troops here and there,
The Singhs began slaughtering enemy Mughal soldiers.
As the Singhs waylaid the Mughals either from the front or the rearguard,
Pathan soldiers were helpless in locating the Khalsa positions.

blocks.text: The Singhs, after ransacking and destroying Noordin Sarai1 , They looted and plundered the town of Sangharkot2 . Thereafter, they massacred the populace of village Majitha3 , Thus avenging the persecution of Singhs by its feudal lords. (2)
lines: The Singhs, after ransacking and destroying Noordin Sarai1 ,
They looted and plundered the town of Sangharkot2 .
Thereafter, they massacred the populace of village Majitha3 ,
Thus avenging the persecution of Singhs by its feudal lords.

blocks.text: Then the Singhs decided to destroy village Karma Chhina4 , For avenging the persecution of Singh warriors Karam Singh and Dharam Singh. As the Singhs laid a siege to this enemy village, Its entire populace came out to fight with the Singhs. (3)
lines: Then the Singhs decided to destroy village Karma Chhina4 ,
For avenging the persecution of Singh warriors Karam Singh and Dharam Singh.
As the Singhs laid a siege to this enemy village,
Its entire populace came out to fight with the Singhs.

blocks.text: The Singhs, after slaughtering those who came out, Entered the village along with those who rushed back. After slaughtering a large number and plundering the village, The Singhs laid a siege to the fort of feudal lord Karma. (4)
lines: The Singhs, after slaughtering those who came out,
Entered the village along with those who rushed back.
After slaughtering a large number and plundering the village,
The Singhs laid a siege to the fort of feudal lord Karma.

blocks.text: Anticipating that the moment of truth had arrived for him, Karma Chhina knew that Singhs would not spare his life. Gathering all his wives numbering thirteen, He got them slaughtered (before his own eyes). (5)
lines: Anticipating that the moment of truth had arrived for him,
Karma Chhina knew that Singhs would not spare his life.
Gathering all his wives numbering thirteen,
He got them slaughtered (before his own eyes).

blocks.text: As the Singhs took possession of the fort after many days, Karma Chinna took shelter in the loft at the top. As he had run short of all his explosives and ammunition, He started pelting stones on the Singhs below. (6)
lines: As the Singhs took possession of the fort after many days,
Karma Chinna took shelter in the loft at the top.
As he had run short of all his explosives and ammunition,
He started pelting stones on the Singhs below.

blocks.text: Then the Singhs after climbing up the loft at the top, Filled up the loft by heaping stones into it. As the Singhs, after climbing, occupied the loft as well, The arrogant Karma Chhina hid himself under the loft. (7)
lines: Then the Singhs after climbing up the loft at the top,
Filled up the loft by heaping stones into it.
As the Singhs, after climbing, occupied the loft as well,
The arrogant Karma Chhina hid himself under the loft.

blocks.text: Then the Singhs made such a heavy shower of bullets, That they damaged the entire roof the loft. Realising that he could never escape the wrath of Singhs, He felt repentant for his acts of criminality. (8)
lines: Then the Singhs made such a heavy shower of bullets,
That they damaged the entire roof the loft.
Realising that he could never escape the wrath of Singhs,
He felt repentant for his acts of criminality.

blocks.text: He understood that the Singh would never spare him, For he had committed so many evil deeds. Then he made a fresh proposal to the Singhs, That he would like to fight single handed with a Singh. (9)
lines: He understood that the Singh would never spare him,
For he had committed so many evil deeds.
Then he made a fresh proposal to the Singhs,
That he would like to fight single handed with a Singh.

blocks.text: Then, there was Sukha Singh - the carpenter among the Singhs, Who was very famous as a resident of Mari Kambo Ki5 . He had participated in a number of battles, Which would be narrated in detail later on. (10)
lines: Then, there was Sukha Singh - the carpenter among the Singhs,
Who was very famous as a resident of Mari Kambo Ki5 .
He had participated in a number of battles,
Which would be narrated in detail later on.

blocks.text: Sukha Singh challenged Karma Chhina to fight single-handedly with him, Without being scared of attack from any other side. Giving him an option to fight in a hand to hand scuffle, He could try boxing, pelting stones or wielding a stick. (11)
lines: Sukha Singh challenged Karma Chhina to fight single-handedly with him,
Without being scared of attack from any other side.
Giving him an option to fight in a hand to hand scuffle,
He could try boxing, pelting stones or wielding a stick.

blocks.text: Assuring him of having no fear of assault by arrows or bullets, Sukha Singh gave him an option of attacking or being attacked first. At this Karma Chhina, holding on to his steel shield, Jumped into the fray with a leap like that of a lion. (12)
lines: Assuring him of having no fear of assault by arrows or bullets,
Sukha Singh gave him an option of attacking or being attacked first.
At this Karma Chhina, holding on to his steel shield,
Jumped into the fray with a leap like that of a lion.

blocks.text: Asking him to avail of the opportunity to attack first, Sukha Singh opted to retaliate after the former's blow. As Karma Chhina made a dash with his spear, Sukha Singh repulsed his attack with a shield. (13)
lines: Asking him to avail of the opportunity to attack first,
Sukha Singh opted to retaliate after the former's blow.
As Karma Chhina made a dash with his spear,
Sukha Singh repulsed his attack with a shield.

blocks.text: Soon after, Sukha Singh wielding his own sword, Sliced Karma Chhina's body into two parts. This was how Sukha Singh slaughtered Karma Chhina, And listen further to other exploits of Sukha Singh. (14)
lines: Soon after,
Sukha Singh wielding his own sword,
Sliced Karma Chhina's body into two parts.
This was how Sukha Singh slaughtered Karma Chhina,
And listen further to other exploits of Sukha Singh.

blocks.text: As the Mughal troops came to dominate the region, They prohibited the Sikhs from having a dip in sacred pool at Amritsar. As large Mughal army put up a camp at Amritsar, The Sikhs were desperate to hold a religious congregation there. (15)
lines: As the Mughal troops came to dominate the region,
They prohibited the Sikhs from having a dip in sacred pool at Amritsar.
As large Mughal army put up a camp at Amritsar,
The Sikhs were desperate to hold a religious congregation there.
